pr.title: Qualify R0002 prayer ingress, cache recovery and optional dates
pr.body:
R0002's prayer admission owners were already audited, but README coverage and actual Chromium/Firefox qualification were missing. This documents the existing rejection, cache-preservation, optional-date and recovery behavior, retains the sealed worker's useful cases, and qualifies the real widget with the delivered R0007 runner. No runtime source changes.

Validation:
- 135 affected source checks pass, with the original admission and mutation controls unchanged.
- 72 selected native cases: invalid ingress and real 60-second recovery, corrupt and valid caches, optional Hijri formats/dialogs, ordinary/suffix/polar compatibility, root/offline/iframe.
- Independent review binds the first actual prayer-text frames, all completed prayer tuples, and every required residual predicate. All 46 raw capture-ordinal PARTIAL statuses and 10 pre-glyph Firefox locator frames remain explicit.
- Two initial acquisitions of the added distinct cache control exposed a current/prefetch fixture routing error. Both originals are retained; the independently reviewed day-bound correction is qualified in both browsers, and the stronger checker rejects the originals.
- All 135 runtime files match the accepted R0007 inventory. Eight exact Moon/motion/preference controls are reused with input, observer, browser and 91-file bindings.
- Fresh public root and frozen V1 consumer checks pass in both browsers with exact served-source identity.

See the [qualification packet](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/a520650fa53f9ad48fd9e77151c3b23d9e797069/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0002/README.md), [independent review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/a520650fa53f9ad48fd9e77151c3b23d9e797069/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0002/qualification/independent-review.md), and [native manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/a520650fa53f9ad48fd9e77151c3b23d9e797069/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0002/manifest.json).

Implements #2. Merge/deployment remains reserved to the owner's exact-head decision. The issue must stay open until post-merge source/docs/public-consumer verification, publication and readback of the individual R0002 closure certificate, and manual completed closure with final readback.
### Final independent readback of the published head

**PASS at `a520650fa53f9ad48fd9e77151c3b23d9e797069`. Every independently executable R0002 qualification is finished and reviewed; no blocker remains.**

The separate independent readback completed all 30 checks: 1,161 manifest members matched exact committed bytes; 74 raw traces recovered their original bytes; 190 frame references retained original video/trace/input associations. README, fixtures, checker and all 135 runtime members remained unchanged from the source/native review. Immutable public README, packet, manifest and review bytes matched; the current public runtime matched its qualified hash. The original issue body and accepted audit comment remained unchanged. This is pre-delivery qualification and currentness, not a merge or closure claim.

Readback identities retained outside the candidate to avoid a self-reference cycle:
- Report SHA256: `248e37e40e9e64e184555071e212cef32ed292c6840409cac9f728733de1a317`
- Machine receipt SHA256: `1558827e1da1d9d4ba78c8b84f88f385127342a554b53ffccf99fcab105aa22b`
- Candidate tree: `d07872441e401cf2d893acb7633715ced73a5cc8`
- Manifest SHA256: `f8d615d9886db590022a52ce5dffe766b53f4a957c12bd036f7f354fdf8b1177`

Only the owner's reserved decision on merge/deployment of this exact head remains before the authorized delivery, certificate and completed-closure sequence.
